observations.description: With T-GM (Timing - Grand Master) enabled system like ACX7024, ACX7348 and ACX7332, when primary port link comes up late, then PTP system servo state can move from INITIALIZING to PHASE ALIGNED. This does not cause any issue since when in INITIALIZING state, no PTP packets are sent to down streams devices and in PHASE ALIGNED state, PTP packets are sent with all correct clock parameters. When system moves to directly PHASE_ALIGNED, it is assured that the system is internally locked to phase and frequency of GNSS.
